title: Move between modes
note: Choose the import route for the destination mode, regardless of where the archive was exported. For a fresh selected local universe, use yoke universe import ARCHIVE. For a self-hosted bundle, stop its core service and use yoke self-host import ARCHIVE --dir BUNDLE. For a hosted destination, use Import in its Universe portability controls. Each route replaces destination state and establishes destination credential authority; copied source credentials do not remain usable. See the portability guide for preparation and recovery.
